_comment: Goat Arcade's Metabase collections and permissions (GA.3, D109), applied by vm/metabase_content.py. A 'Goat Arcade' parent collection with one collection per team: every Metabase user (All Users) can view all of them, each team's group can edit its own. Data: every group, All Users included, may query the Goat Arcade database with the query builder; only the groups in 'native_sql' (and Administrators, untouched) get the SQL editor. The groups and who is in them are config/metabase/people.json.

parent.name: Goat Arcade
parent.description: Goat Arcade's dashboards, one collection per team. The dashboards here are kept as code (config/metabase/goat-arcade in the Annex repo): changes made in Metabase to them are overwritten at the next platform push. Save your own questions next to them.
